import html # Pre‑defined template for the profile page. PROFILE_FORMAT = """

{name}

{bio}

Status: {status}
""" def render_profile_page(fullname: str, biography: str, status_message: str) -> str: """ Render a user profile page from the provided data. Parameters ---------- fullname : str The user's full name. biography : str A multi‑sentence biography provided by the user. status_message : str A brief, current status update from the user. Returns ------- str A string containing the sanitized and formatted user profile information. Raises ------ ValueError If any of the required arguments is empty or consists only of whitespace. """ # Basic validation: ensure all inputs are non‑empty after stripping if not fullname or not fullname.strip(): raise ValueError("fullname must be a non‑empty string") if not biography or not biography.strip(): raise ValueError("biography must be a non‑empty string") if not status_message or not status_message.strip(): raise ValueError("status_message must be a non‑empty string") # Escape HTML special characters to prevent XSS attacks safe_name = html.escape(fullname.strip()) safe_bio = html.escape(biography.strip()).replace("\n", "
") safe_status = html.escape(status_message.strip()) # Render the template with sanitized values return PROFILE_FORMAT.format(name=safe_name, bio=safe_bio, status=safe_status).strip()
